subject: Lebanon
assessment: ANALYSIS: Lebanon's friction stems from collapsed banking, sectarian deadlock, infrastructure decay, and refugee burdens eroding systemic resilience. RESOLUTION: Protocol deployment initiates fiscal stabilization, technical assistance for renewable energy micro-grids, digital customs modernization, and reform-linked conditional financing. DISPATCH: Creative skills -> Media Reconstruction & Narrative Shaping Avenues; Technical skills -> Renewable Energy & ICT Infrastructure Avenues; Operational skills -> Supply Chain Resilience & Port Logistics Optimization Avenues; Labor skills -> Diaspora-Enabled Workforce Upskilling & Refugee Integration Programs Avenues; Intellectual skills -> Sectarian Conflict Resolution Policy Design & Governance Reform Avenues -> Global Industry Avenues.
